item.content:encoded:
Even for an old article, it seems to me like something that really should be polished. It isn't bad, and as simple as the concept is, it is still valid, but needs more work.

First thing, a problem of the time, this skip work better as Euclid. It isn't particularly hard to contain, and the danger drops when you know to watch for it. There are some details that can arguably make it Keter, but it just seems to be there to make it Keter, and this isn't helping the article, actually.

The description is confuse, and the addendums should be simply a part of it. There aren't many things that need to be changed, only the parts that make it OTT dangerous, but the structure of the text itself calls for a rewrite for clarity.

I like the logs until the Venus Flytrap. Instead of Expunged it could be developed further, even maybe revealing some hinting to the origins of this anomaly. The pig could be changed so it doesn't work right, but still creates something strange and creepy without need for the same level of danger.

And the last addendum is simply silly. It develops an ability completely unrelated to everything previously seen, just for the sake of becoming even more dangerous.

For now, I'm downvoting, not out of complete dislike, but because I want to someday see this rewritten into a better article, or at least a more readable one.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
@zankou - ah sorry I assumed you meant "ceased to move".

"seized" means to take something by force (i.e "the contraband was seized by customs") and doesn't really refer to medical seizures in modern English I think.

I think better word would be "convulsed", "started convulsing", "suffered a seizure" or similar.
